test_title: SSC MTS Previous Year Paper (Held on: 26 July 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Select the figure from among the given options that can replace the question mark (?) in the following series.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/188500ec8c3aa3b9c3b7f75be767072a805011bef18790ca6ea2a6028833c9fb.png]
solution:
The pattern followed here is, an increment of a number of lines:

**Number of lines present in the box is in a prime number.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/188500ec8c3aa3b9c3b7f75be767072a805011bef18790ca6ea2a6028833c9fb.png] 

 (7) (11) (13) (17) **(19)**

 
• Option 1: [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e205ce3c1f5ccc63078d27ff33e815ff1337b3ae844e577b902d3bf584650220.png] Number of lines: 29
 
• **Option 2: [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/139f6a8d3068b8bae3411e80fd6f9006a85096df43ebf1ff728fe059452c52dc.png] Number of lines: 19**
 
• Option 3: [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f8c8f8b12a429f62d4729213c378dc5f11c26b931b915046afe2e4d34800e03e.png] Number of lines: 31
 
• Option 4: [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4c05733bde6e8b8e41b3a10666c8434307f73db3be0f440ca183519b94ea429c.png] Number of lines: 25

Hence, the answer is **option 2**.
